item.title: Family of woman killed in Mexico forced to create new Facebook campaign group after copyright infringement report
item.description: The ‘Justice for Kiara’ Facebook group - which has now been taken down - was started by Kiara Agnew’s family after she was killed in Mexico in 2023 and her boyfriend, Ryan Friesen, found not guilty of femicide. That verdict has since been overturned, with Friesen launching an appeal.
